title: Seeing the Voice, Preserving the Self: A Participatory Design Approach to Deaf-Centric Text-to-Speech
reasoning: The paper focuses on participatory design for Deaf-centric text-to-speech (TTS) interfaces. While it includes a section on the ethical considerations and privacy concerns of voice cloning (FATE framework), it does not evaluate, benchmark, or study moral, ethical, or religious reasoning capabilities within AI systems.
